name: Kankin ~Joshikousei Ryoujoku Choukyou~
original_name: 監禁　～女子校生凌辱調教～
source:
Sexual-training sim game involving a young girl and middle-aged man. He abandons himself to despair because of a signal of cancer in his body...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ013349.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
围绕一名年幼少女与中年男子展开的监禁调教模拟游戏。因察觉身体出现癌症征兆而自暴自弃、陷入绝望的男人，向少女伸出了魔爪……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ013349.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
